name: Dead By Roblox
desc:
Dead By Roblox is an asymmetrical multiplayer (4v1) horror game where one player takes on the role of the savage Killer, and the other four play as Survivors, trying to escape the Killer and being caught, and sent back to the lobby, all while repairing generators so they can escape.

DbR has been moved to this place: https://www.roblox.com/games/14904820737/Dead-by-Roblox

Game as of now ONLY has mobile support for survivors.

If you have any questions join our server.
